_about: Owner-editable bars for the detection evaluation (npm run eval:detection). A rule marked 'validated' in src/detection/registry.ts must meet its bar at gateSensitivity over ALL fixtures, or the command exits 1. A rule marked 'experimental' is only reported against its bar; its bar is the target the owner wants real recordings to reach before moving it to 'validated'. See README.md in this folder.

promotion._about: A rule can be promoted only when its bar is met on REAL fixtures alone and those fixtures contain at least this many labelled events for it.

_about_the_validated_bars: The two validated bars below are a regression ratchet, not a goal: set just under what the unchanged shipped rule scores on the committed synthetic fixtures, which include scenes drawn on purpose to fool it (chin rest, drinking, covering a yawn). WS3 (fewer false alarms) should raise minPrecision as it improves.
_about_withControls: WS3. The bars for the two validated mouth rules with the false_positive_controls flag ON (npm run eval:detection plays everything three ways). withControls is judged on the single scenes with the chin-rest rule on; withLearning on the sequence fixtures (a pose rejected five times, then a real bite) with a simulated person tapping Not a bite. Each precision bar is set just under what was measured when WS3 landed: a ratchet, to be raised when the controls improve and never lowered to make a change pass. controlsMaxRecallDrop is the plan's acceptance line: recall with the controls no more than this far below the shipped detector's.
